Both are already linked to 207 common concepts, including ethnicity, mother and urbanization, which suggests the methods and data needed to connect them already exist. We propose a study that uses ethnicity as a bridge: first, review how disease and income distribution are each currently treated through ethnicity; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.

We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.

We propose a study that uses molecule as a bridge: first, review how computer simulation and network topology are each currently treated through molecule; second, design an approach that combines them and test it on established benchmarks from both lines of work; third, measure whether the combination improves on each topic studied alone. We expect the work to clarify where the two literatures overlap and to open a new line of research between them.
